notes: Checked the full body, not just the hunk. `pos = (s32 *)&SPAD->unkA8[id][i]` and the header-comment update use the existing ScrPad view (0xA8 + id*0x108 + i*0xC, the same bytes as the retired literal), so item 4 is improved and the comment is true. Item 3: the do-while(0) carries a FAKE label with its observed seat swap. dx/dy/dz, temp and temp2 are Ruling 11 locals whose comments are true: every dx write is point.x - base.x. `lz = ~1; lz &= sp_tmp` is load-bearing (ablated to `sp_tmp & ~1`: score 3 at each site). It is a truthful respelling under Ruling 1(3): no dead store, and nothing false is asserted. D_800A37E8/EA/EC are written by their own names, so there is no cross-symbol access here. The scratch record at 0x1F8002B8 (`scr + 0x60/0xA8/0xC8/...`) has no declared type in any header, so its raw offsets are recorded debt, not item 4. sandbox --disable all = 0 (416/416, re-measured).
